svg.title: An ordinary day: the residual and the running sum
svg.desc: 240 readings with nothing broken and the door open for 62 of them. The residual jumps by up to three degrees in the step after the door opens or shuts and sits within a few tenths otherwise. The running sum climbs at each door and drains away again, peaking at 3.1 against a threshold of 8.3.
svg.text: what the room did minus what the model said
